text:
Maria: Heads up — CI is failing on the audit-telemetry assertions job after the RBAC PR landed. Tests failing for customer-facing audit events (role missing). CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/eng-security/4567 :warning:
Alex: Looking now. Quick skim — the rbac->principal rename might have removed actor.role mapping in the extractor.
Jordan: Failing assertion snippet from the validator:```py
# audit_event_validator.py
assert event['actor']['role'] is not None, 'actor.role must be present for customer audit events'
```
Maria: Exactly. We expect role for compliance customers. This is breaking golden-fixture based CI which compares production-shaped events.
sre-bot: build #4567 failed: audit-telemetry-assertions — 12 failures. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/eng-security/4567/console
Kevin: Short-term mitigation: change validator to tolerate missing role for internal-only events, but we need to keep strict for customer-scoped streams. Prefer updating the extractor to populate actor.role from principal.roles[0] where applicable.
Tina: Repro steps I used locally: checkout main + PR merge commit, run `./scripts/run-audit-validation --fixtures=golden/customer-events` — you can see the nulls in actor fields. Branch with failing test: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/890 (my fork).
Alex: If extractor change is the fix, we should also add an assert in CI that the golden fixtures include actor.role for all customer-facing files. Prevents regressions.
Maria: I'll open a tiny PR that restores actor.role mapping in audit-extractor and adds a golden fixture with explicit actor.role and an extra CI smoke that validates that field. Tagging @Kevin for review.
Kevin: Sounds good. Also file a quick postmortem note in incidents/ if this touched customer audit delivery to be safe.
Jordan: FYI — there was a similar brittle test a few months ago where we relied on a default mapping that got removed. Recommend adding a short comment in the validator explaining why actor.role is required (regulatory reasons).
Maria: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/891 — includes extractor change + golden fixture + test. CI green on my fork, still flaky on main due to unrelated infra flakes. I'll coordinate with eng-infra if it keeps failing. :thumbsup:
Tina: Thanks — once merged, can someone trigger a small rollout to dedicated to verify downstream pipeline preserves role field?
Maria: Yep — will coordinate with eng-platform. If CI fails again, we'll revert the RBAC PR and roll forward with a fix.
